# Chat reference

The chat component, the player identity every social module keys on, the chat line data and the server-side chat router. For how to use it, see [Chat](../modules/chat.md).

## VtUnitChat

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Chat → VtUnitChat**. Adds [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

A player's chat: sends lines, receives the lines routed to it, keeps a short history, and holds the player's ignore list. Opt in through `VtUnitDefinition.useChat`; `VtUnit` attaches it.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtUnit Unit { get; }` | The unit this chat belongs to. |
| `string PlayerId { get; }` | The sender id used for ignores and mutes: the player id, or a per-unit id without an identity. |
| `string DisplayName { get; }` | The name other players see. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtChatMessage> History { get; }` | Recent received lines, oldest first, capped at `VtTuning.chatHistorySize`. |
| `IReadOnlyCollection<string> Ignored { get; }` | Player ids whose lines this player does not receive. |
| `event Action<VtChatMessage> OnMessageReceived` | Fires for every line delivered to this player. |
| `event Action OnIgnoreListChanged` | Fires after the ignore list changed. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache the sibling unit and player identity. Safe to call more than once; call it after adding the component or a `VtPlayerIdentity` at runtime. |
| `bool Send(VtChatChannel channel, string text, out VtChatFailureReason reason)` | Send `text` on `channel`. On a networked client it is forwarded and this returns false. |
| `bool Send(VtChatChannel channel, string text, string whisperTo, out VtChatFailureReason reason)` | Send `text` on `channel`; `whisperTo` names the player for whispers. |
| `bool Whisper(string playerNameOrId, string text, out VtChatFailureReason reason)` | Whisper `text` to the online player with this name or id. |
| `bool Ignore(string playerId)` | Stop receiving lines from `playerId`. Forwards on a networked client. |
| `bool Unignore(string playerId)` | Receive lines from `playerId` again. Forwards on a networked client. |
| `bool IsIgnoring(string playerId)` | True when lines from `playerId` are ignored. |
| `void Deliver(VtChatMessage message)` | Hand a routed line to this player: stores it in the history and raises `OnMessageReceived`. The router calls it on the server; your transport calls it on the owning client. |
| `void ClearHistory()` | Empty the history. |
| `void ApplyIgnoreListFromNet(IEnumerable<string> playerIds)` | Replace the ignore list. Used by loading and replication; not authority-gated. |

## VtPlayerIdentity

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Social → VtPlayerIdentity**.

Who a player unit belongs to: a stable player id and a display name that outlive the unit, the scene and the session. Chat whispers, guilds, friends and mail address players through it.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Player Id (`playerId`) | `string` | Empty | Stable player id: a Steam ID, an account id or a local profile id. Assigned by the server. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty | Name other players see. Empty shows the player id. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `string PlayerId { get; }` | The stable player id, or empty before one is assigned. |
| `string DisplayName { get; }` | The name to show; the player id when no name is set. |
| `bool HasId { get; }` | True once a player id is assigned. |
| `VtUnit Unit { get; }` | The unit on the same object, or null. |
| `static IReadOnlyCollection<VtPlayerIdentity> Online { get; }` | Every online identity. |
| `event Action<VtPlayerIdentity> OnIdentityChanged` | Fires after `Assign` changed the id or name. |
| `static event Action<VtPlayerIdentity> OnPlayerOnline` | Fires when a player id comes online in this process. |
| `static event Action<VtPlayerIdentity> OnPlayerOffline` | Fires when a player id goes offline in this process. |
| `static VtPlayerIdentity FindById(string id)` | The online identity with `id`, or null. |
| `static VtPlayerIdentity FindByName(string name)` | The online identity whose display name matches `name` ignoring case, or null. |
| `static VtPlayerIdentity Find(string idOrName)` | The online identity matching `idOrName` by id first, then by name. |
| `void Assign(string newPlayerId, string newDisplayName)` | Set the player id and display name. The server calls this at login; replication calls it on clients. |

## VtChatMessage

Serializable struct.

One delivered chat line. System and Npc lines are usually localization keys; read `DisplayText` and `DisplaySender` so each client shows them in its own language.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Channel (`channel`) | [VtChatChannel](#vtchatchannel) | `Say` | Channel the line was sent on. |
| Sender Id (`senderId`) | `string` | Empty | Player id of the sender. Empty for System and Npc lines. |
| Sender Name (`senderName`) | `string` | Empty | Sender name as sent; a localization key on localizable lines. Show DisplaySender instead. |
| Recipient Id (`recipientId`) | `string` | Empty | Player id of the whisper target. Empty on other channels. |
| Recipient Name (`recipientName`) | `string` | Empty | Display name of the whisper target. Empty on other channels. |
| Text (`text`) | `string` | Empty | The line as sent, or a localization key on localizable lines. Show DisplayText instead. |
| Localizable (`localizable`) | `bool` | Off | On when text and sender name are localization keys that each client resolves in its own language. |
| Time (`time`) | `double` | 0 | When the line was routed, in seconds on the chat clock. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `string DisplayText { get; }` | The text to show, localized when the message is localizable. |
| `string DisplaySender { get; }` | The sender name to show, localized when the message is localizable. |

## VtChat

Static class.

The chat router. Runs on the authority: cleans and checks a message, finds the recipients for its channel, and delivers it to each recipient's `VtUnitChat`. Players reach it through `VtUnitChat.Send`; server code posts system and NPC lines with `SendSystem` and `SendNpc`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static Func<double> Clock { get; set; }` | Seconds used for rate limits, mutes and message times. Null restores real time. |
| `static event Action<VtChatMessage, int> OnMessageRouted` | Fires on the authority for every routed message, with the number of recipients. |
| `static Func<VtUnitChat, string, string> FilterFn` | Rewrite or refuse player text after the built-in checks. Return the text to send, or null to refuse with `VtChatFailureReason.Filtered`. Null filter sends as is. |
| `static Func<VtUnitChat, List<VtUnitChat>, bool> GuildRecipientsFn` | Fill the list with the online guild members who should receive the sender's guild chat, the sender included, and return true; return false when the sender has no guild. Set by the guild module. |
| `static void Mute(string playerId, float seconds)` | Mute `playerId` for `seconds`. A negative duration mutes until `Unmute`. |
| `static void Unmute(string playerId)` | Lift a mute. |
| `static bool IsMuted(string playerId)` | True while `playerId` is muted. |
| `static void ResetState()` | Forget every sender's rate budget and every mute. |
| `static bool TrySend(VtUnitChat sender, VtChatChannel channel, string text, string whisperTo, out VtChatFailureReason reason)` | Route a player's message. Called by `VtUnitChat.Send` on the authority. |
| `static int SendSystem(string keyOrText, IEnumerable<VtUnitChat> to = null, bool localizable = true)` | Post a server announcement to `to`, or to every chat component when null. |
| `static int SendNpc(VtUnit speaker, string keyOrText, Vector3 center, float radius, bool localizable = true)` | Post a line spoken by `speaker` to chat components within `radius` of `center`. A radius of 0 reaches everyone. |
| `static string Clean(string text)` | The cleaned form of `text`: trimmed, single line, markup stripped unless allowed. |

## Enums

### VtChatChannel

Where a chat message goes. Serialized as int; append-only.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Say` | Players within `VtTuning.chatSayRange` of the sender. |
| `Yell` | Players within `VtTuning.chatYellRange` of the sender. |
| `Party` | The sender's party. |
| `Guild` | The sender's guild. Needs the guild module. |
| `Whisper` | One player by name or id, echoed to the sender. |
| `System` | Server announcements. Players cannot send on it. |
| `Npc` | Lines spoken by non-player units, such as boss yells. Players cannot send on it. |

### VtChatFailureReason

Why a chat send refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The message was sent. |
| `EmptyText` | Nothing left after trimming and stripping markup. |
| `TooLong` | Longer than `VtTuning.chatMaxLength`. |
| `RateLimited` | Sent faster than the chat limit allows. |
| `Muted` | The sender is muted. |
| `Filtered` | The filter rejected the text. |
| `NoRecipient` | The whisper target is not online, or is the sender. |
| `NotInParty` | Party chat without a party. |
| `NotInGuild` | Guild chat without a guild. |
| `ChannelNotAllowed` | Players cannot send on System or Npc. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the message was forwarded. |
